description: Chris Hunkeler hikes from the US Signal Station past Musket Redoubt towards a lookout point. Tall, dry grass lines the hiking path. US Signal Station, 1941 Nearly two centuries after Rodney recognized its importance, Pigeon Island was again used as a strategic base, during World War II. This US Signal Station was built over Rodney’s existing mortar battery dating from 1780, and Pigeon Island served as a US naval communications signal station until 1947.
